name: Castlevania: Nocturne
description: As revolution sweeps France, Richter Belmont fights to uphold his family's legacy and prevent the rise of a ruthless, power-hungry vampire ruler.

videos.title: A Common Enemy in Evil
videos.overview: An attack on their camp spurs vampire hunter Richter and young mage Maria to seek the help of the Abbot of Machecoul. Strangers bring news from abroad.

videos.title: Horror Beyond Nightmares
videos.overview: As the threat of a Vampire Messiah looms, Tera's past holds dark omens for the future. Annette, Edouard, Richter and Maria head for the château.

videos.title: Freedom Was Sweeter
videos.overview: In shock after a loss, Annette shares the story of her escape from slavery and her journey from Saint-Domingue. Chaos erupts at a public gathering.

videos.title: Horrors Rising from the Earth
videos.overview: Olrox voices doubts to Mizrak about the Abbot's alliances. Desperate to help a friend, Annette leads a risky mission over Richter's objections.

videos.title: The Natural Order
videos.overview: Drolta makes a persuasive pitch to Olrox, and Annette encounters an old enemy. Revelations shed new light on Maria and Richter's family histories.

videos.title: Guilty Men to Be Judged
videos.overview: While Richter learns about the Belmont legacy, Annette searches for the wisdom of her own ancestors. Edouard attempts to get through to a comrade.

videos.title: Blood Is the Only Way
videos.overview: Emboldened by her victories, the Vampire Messiah steps into the spotlight. Richter flexes new abilities. Olrox makes a surprising proposal.

videos.title: Devourer of Light
videos.overview: With the Abbot poised to make an unthinkable sacrifice and Erzsebet's plans already in motion, Richter and his allies hurl themselves into battle.

videos.title: A Living Legend
videos.overview: Alucard seeks help from Richter and his friends in the wake of a devastating loss. Elsewhere, Erzsebet makes plans to conquer Paris.

videos.title: Angel of Death
videos.overview: Drolta's dark past unfolds as Alucard, Annette and Richter set out in search of Sekhmet's missing soul. Maria encounters her mother in her new form.

videos.title: The Widow's Window
videos.overview: As Maria's magic intensifies, Mizrak urges the Abbot to repent and reverse his loyalties. Alucard's party arrives in Paris at the height of revolution.

videos.title: Monstrous Things
videos.overview: Annette, Richter and Alucard seek Sekhmet's mummy at the Louvre, where spirits seem to be lighting the way. Juste intervenes in a deadly confrontation.

videos.title: Into the Abyss
videos.overview: Maria confronts her dark side as Annette and Richter follow orders to find and destroy the city's undead. Olrox considers his fate in the fight ahead.

videos.title: Ancestors
videos.overview: Annette embarks on a perilous journey into the spirit world that sparks a shocking transformation — and sets the stage for an epic showdown.

videos.title: Grenadye Alaso
videos.overview: Chaos erupts under a blood-red sky as the battle for Paris begins, with Alucard's allies on one side and Erzsebet's army on the other.

videos.title: A Line of Great Heroes
videos.overview: With the future at stake, Richter and friends join forces against a terrifying new evil that puts their powers — and the Belmont legacy — to the test.
